case_title: RAMABORA @ RAMABORAIAH & ANR. v. STATE OF KARNATAKA
high_court_outcome: Convicted A-1 and A-2 of murder, acquitted others
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleged that 22 individuals formed an unlawful assembly and entered the house of the deceased, committing murder. The case relied on the testimony of the deceased's mother and maternal uncle, who claimed the accused assaulted the deceased with weapons. However, the prosecution's evidence was inconsistent, with conflicting accounts of the weapons used and the roles of the accused. The trial court found the evidence unreliable and acquitted all accused. The High Court overturned the acquittal of two accused, finding their involvement in the murder was supported by the testimony of the witnesses, but the Supreme Court set aside the High Court's conviction, finding the evidence insufficient to support the conviction of the two accused.
